observations.content: Assistant worked on /home/coder/workspaces/learn/extensions/subagent-types/index.ts, adding a two-way message channel between main and subagents via paseo-channel.

edit tool call failed three times: 'Could not find edits[2]' because oldText did not match file exactly, first due to typo 'interrupted-and-replaces' vs file's 'interrupted-and-replaced' and wrong indentation, then due to dropping the 'details: {}' line and mis-tabbing '};'.
Assistant used awk + cat -A (bytes dumped) on lines 541-566 to see exact tabs/whitespace; file uses box-drawing char u+2500 for header dashes and em-dash u+2014 in comments and strings.
Second full edit also failed: edits[2] oldText had four tabs before '};' where file has three, and dropped the 'details: {}' line.

Assistant split edits into 5 smaller blocks avoiding exact dash counting in the header; edit succeeded: 'Successfully replaced 5 block(s)'. Changes rewrote message_subagent tool to support interrupt:true and turn-boundary pickup.

message_subagent tool updated: default is turn-boundary pickup (busy child receives at next round, idle child gets new turn), interrupt:true opts into daemon interrupt-and-replace for urgent redirects; builds a ChannelMessage with id/from/fromRole/text/ts and calls sendToSubagent with interrupt flag; returns queued vs delivered vs interrupted result text.

Inbound drain added: flushInbound() drains file queue on turn_end, before_agent_start, and agent_settled events (atomic rename-based drain, only first caller gets entries), with a drainInFlight guard.
Import line changed to also bring in drainQueue, renderForPrompt, and type ChannelMessage from ./paseo-channel.ts.
CHILD to MAIN comment updated: never interrupts; busy main gets persistent file queue delivered at next turn boundary by its own drain, idle main gets steer-back as new turn.

Assistant then edited message_main execute to push a ChannelMessage to sendToMain instead of a pre-wrapped <subagent-message> text string; first attempt failed 'Could not find edits[0]' again due to tab mismatch on '};' (4 vs 3 tabs).
Second message_main execute edit attempt also failed 'Could not find edits[0]'; grep+awk showed message_main code at line 634 still using the <subagent-message> template literal.
Assistant narrowed to 2-line core edit (template literal line + sendToMain line) plus two separate string edits, but it still failed 'Could not find edits[0]'.
Assistant gave up on the edit tool for this block and used a python3 heredoc script with asserts to replace 4 blocks directly in index.ts; output 'OK - 4 replacements applied'.

Python replacements: message_main now builds a ChannelMessage and calls sendToMain(endpoint, mainId, msg); result text changed to 'Queued - the main agent picks this up at its next turn boundary (its current work is never interrupted).' and 'Delivered to main agent (new turn started).'; description changed 'mid-turn' to 'mid-run' and 'delivered when it goes idle' to 'delivered at its next turn boundary'.

Assistant attributed earlier edit failures to an invisible character mismatch and noted asserts confirmed exact matches; plan remaining: verify compile, add unit tests for the queue, run bun test + typecheck, then researcher merge + visual-tools header + sync.

Verification output: flushInbound now at lines 347-374 in index.ts (turn_end, before_agent_start, agent_settled handlers present); a CHILD to MAIN comment referencing labels/allowlist appears before the return in the spawn section.

Typecheck attempt with 'bunx tsc --noEmit' printed tsc v7.0.2 usage/help instead of compiling, indicating the invocation was not pointed at a tsconfig/project and produced no type errors; typechecking remains unverified.
